title: Accel Offloads ₹156 Cr Stake In BlackBuck Via Block Deal
summary: As per NSE data, Accel sold the shares at ₹576.05 apiece to rake in the amount. The shares that flooded the market were lapped up by AMC Abakkus Investment Managers
Accel is trimming its stake in BlackBuck to book profits amid a healthy uptick in the logistics company’s share price, revenues and profits
Founded in 2015, BlackBuck operates an online B2B marketplace for inter-city full FTL transportation. It also offers telematics solutions and vehicle financing to truck operators

title: Amazon Pay To Double Down On Insurance With New Offerings
summary: Amazon Pay India CEO Vikas Bansal said that the company is expanding its insurance offerings to include travel insurance and ​other products
The expansion plans are part of Amazon Pay’s strategy to evolve into a broader financial service platform, comprising credit, insurance and savings and investment products
As part of its financial services push, Amazon Pay so far this year has launched fixed deposits and rolled out a co-branded credit card for small businesses on Amazon Business

title: Mitti Labs Enters Deal With Google For 1 Mn Carbon Credits
summary: Mitti Labs has signed a four-year Google offtake deal to supply 1 Mn carbon credits through 2030
The deal could help scale methane-reduction and water-saving practices across rice farms while giving farmers an additional income stream through carbon credits

The credits will primarily come from projects across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Karnataka, with Mitti Labs currently covering more than 100,000 hectares and targeting expansion to millions of hectares

title: GFF 2026: Here Are The New Launches Announced On Day 3
summary: The GFF came to a close today with a final wave of new developments from the fintech ecosystem
Following yesterday’s focus on partnerships, today returned to a series of product launches
BharatPeX launched an enterprise payment gateway, PayU rolled out its Agent HQ platform, and Nitin Gadkari launched a portability solution for FASTags

title: [Update] RentoMojo IPO Ends With 72.88X Subscription, QIB Portion Booked 177X
push_existing: Furniture and appliance rental startup RentoMojo’s IPO closed with an overall subscription of 72.88X on the final day of bidding today
summary: RentoMojo’s IPO closed with an overall subscription of 72.88X, receiving bids for 158.68 Cr shares.
Institutional investors drove the surge on the final day, with the QIB portion subscribed 177.29X after remaining undersubscribed at the end of Day 2.
The NII portion was subscribed 67.93X, followed by the employee portion at 21.03X and the retail portion at 15.59X.

title: Fintech Stocks Rally On Report Of 40 Basis Point MDR On UPI, Paytm Touches 52-Week High
summary: Pine Labs’ stock surged 16.9%, Mobikwik gained over 8%, AvenuesAI jumped 6.1%, and Paytm’s stock gained 3.9% after reports suggesting that MDR fees on UPI transactions could soon be notified
The proposal could unlock a revenue stream of around ₹5,000-10,000 Cr for payments platforms like the four aforementioned companies, per an earlier research note by Jefferies
MDR fees are likely to be set at around 40 bps of the transaction value for P2M UPI transactions, with third-party app providers receiving roughly 12 bps

title: How Rapido’s Super App Model Is Taking Shape
summary: Rapido is expanding beyond bike taxis into autos, cabs, food delivery and other high-frequency services
The expansion can help Rapido increase app usage while monetising its existing rider and driver network across more categories
Rapido is using its mobility distribution and low-commission model to build a broader everyday consumer platform

title: GFF 2026: NPCI Unveils Unified Ticketing, Takes RuPay Credit Card On UPI To US, UAE
push_existing: RBI executive director Gunveer Singh introduced a comprehensive suite of payment initiatives across digital ticketing and others at GFF 2026
summary: RBI executive director Gunveer Singh introduced a comprehensive suite of payment initiatives spanning digital ticketing, mobility payments and ecommerce at GFF 2026

This adds on the spree of UPI related innovations launched during the GFF 2026, with the NPCI introducing a series of digital infrastructure initiatives to expand credit access across India during the GFF 2026
The Department of Financial Services' secretary Sanjay Lohiya also unveiled open-source android ATMs to instantly issue RuPay cards and merchant UPI QR code

title: Triptii Dimri Backs D2C Brand Peep Beauty As Investor, Co-Creator
summary: Actor Triptii Dimri has joined eye-focused D2C beauty brand Peep Beauty as an investor and co-creator
The startup is leveraging Dimri’s creative involvement and celebrity reach to position coloured contact lenses as everyday beauty and fashion accessories
Founded by former Keventers cofounder Aman Arora, Peep Beauty has raised ₹12 Cr and sells coloured contact lenses and eye makeup products

title: EaseMyTrip Cofounder Nishant Pitti Pledges Shares Worth ₹212 Cr To Motilal Oswal
summary: EaseMyTrip cofounder Nishant Pitti has pledged 34.51 Cr shares worth ₹211.9 Cr to Motilal Oswal Financial Services for personal use.
Nearly 99% of Pitti’s individual holding in EaseMyTrip remains pledged, although the latest transaction has not increased his overall encumbered holding.
Pitti now has 44.87 Cr pledged shares, representing 11.26% of EaseMyTrip’s share capital and 25.83% of the combined promoter-group holding.

title: ESDS Touches Upper Circuit Again, Now Up 306% From IPO Price
push_existing: ESDS shares touched their upper circuit for the sixth consecutive trading session, hitting an intraday high of ₹1,740.40 on the NSE
summary: ESDS shares touched their upper circuit for the sixth consecutive trading session, hitting an intraday high of ₹1,740.40 on the NSE
The rally has taken ESDS shares to more than four times their ₹429 IPO price within six trading sessions, underscoring strong investor appetite for the enterprise cloud and AI infrastructure play
ESDS was trading 9.7% higher at ₹1,735 on the NSE as of 14:00 IST, while remaining locked at the 10% upper circuit of ₹1,716.35 on the BSE

title: Exclusive: Ultraviolette To Raise ₹373 Cr As Manufacturing Facility BIGGA Takes Shape
push_existing: E2W maker Ultraviolette Automotive is set to raise an additional ₹373.04 Cr as part of its ongoing Series E funding round
summary: Electric two-wheeler (E2W) maker Ultraviolette Automotive is set to raise an additional ₹373.04 Cr as part of its ongoing Series E funding round
The funding comes at a time when the E2W maker is investing more than ₹1,000 Cr over the next five years to expand its manufacturing footprint
Of this, Ultraviolette has raised ₹249.2 Cr from Yali Capital’s Yali Deeptech Fund I as well as TDK Ventures

title: Paris Panini Parent Popo Global Raises ₹532 Cr From Artal Asia
push_existing: Popo Global, which operates gourmet food brands including The Pizza Bakery, Paris Panini and Smash Guys, has raised ₹532 Cr from Artal Asia
summary: Popo Global, which operates gourmet food brands including The Pizza Bakery, Paris Panini and Smash Guys, has raised ₹532 Cr from Artal Asia
The investment gives Popo Global financial backing as the Bengaluru-based restaurant company lays the groundwork to expand beyond its home market
Popo Global plans to expand beyond Bengaluru and scale its portfolio of food brands across India

title: OpenAI Open To Slowing AI Development Amid Safety Concerns: Sam Altman
summary: CEO Sam Altman told employees that OpenAI is open to slowing the development of advanced AI systems alongside other leading AI companies
Coordinated action could help prevent competitive pressure from pushing AI companies to release increasingly autonomous systems before adequate safeguards are in place
Separately, OpenAI has paused new subscriptions to its $200-a-month Pro plan amid “unprecedented” demand for Astra, while keeping its other plans and API available

title: UPI MDR May Be Set At 40 Basis Points, Banks Could Get Largest Share: Report
summary: The proposed UPI MDR could be set at around 40 basis points, with issuing banks potentially receiving the largest share of the fee.
An MDR on select merchant payments would give banks and payment companies a direct revenue stream from UPI transactions, which currently attract no merchant fee.
Issuing banks could receive 40% of the MDR, while third-party apps and acquiring banks may get 30% each.

title: PhonePe Shuts Down Engineering Office In The US: Report
summary: The Bay Area team consisted of seven to eight engineers, who worked directly alongside PhonePe’s main mobile platform and engineering teams based in Bengaluru
The decision to close the US office was taken after PhonePe concluded that the operation was not producing sufficient results to justify its continuation
The development comes nearly four years after PhonePe first announced the US office, which was then helmed by former Meta executive Gaurav Lochan. He left PhonePe in July this year

title: From Pixxel To Swish — Indian Startups Raised Over $321.9 Mn This Week
summary: Between September 7 and September 11, 20 startups raised a combined $321.9 Mn, an 82.4% increase from the $176.5 Mn raised by 22 startups in the previous week
Advanced Hardware & Technology was the week’s most-funded sector, with two startups raising a combined $121 Mn
Peak XV Partners, Accel and Prath Ventures were the week’s most active investors, participating in two deals each
